title: System output file
$comment: Mirrors benchmark/evaluator/models.py (SystemOutput, RetrievedContext, Citation) exactly. Describes the output of one system (KAG / HybridRAG / NativeRAG / ...) after its adapter has mapped native output onto this common shape.
description: A system output file is either a bare JSON array of outputs, or an object carrying that array under 'outputs' or 'results'.

systemOutput.description: One system's answer to one question. Additional properties are allowed: adapters may carry extra debug fields beyond this contract, and the evaluator keeps them in an 'extra' bag and ignores them for scoring.

question_id.description: Must match a BenchmarkItem.id from the benchmark dataset.

system.description: Name of the system under test (e.g. 'kag', 'hybridrag', 'nativerag').

citations.description: The citations the ANSWER makes, parsed from the answer text by benchmark/adapters/citation_parser.py. Never build this from retrieved_contexts, from chunk metadata, or from any other channel: a system whose citations are a copy of its retrieval result scores Citation Recall equal to its retrieval recall without the answer pointing at anything. The evaluator flags an exact mirror of retrieved_contexts as a note on the report.

error.description: Non-null marks this output as failed (see SystemOutput.failed).

retrievedContext.description: One retrieved passage as reported by a system's adapter.

rank.description: 1-based rank. Optional: when omitted, the loader falls back to the passage's position in the retrieved_contexts array (1-based).

article.description: Coerced to a string by the Python loader if given as an integer.

clause.description: Coerced to a string by the Python loader if given as an integer.

point.description: Coerced to a string by the Python loader if given as an integer.

score.description: Retrieval score in whatever scale the system uses (graph score, vector distance, BM25, ...). Never compared across systems by the evaluator - only rank, text and location metadata are used for scoring.

citation.description: A source the answer points at, as extracted from the answer text.

article.description: Coerced to a string by the Python loader if given as an integer.

clause.description: Coerced to a string by the Python loader if given as an integer.

point.description: Coerced to a string by the Python loader if given as an integer.

claim_index.description: Index into answer_claims this citation supports, when the adapter can tell. Enables claim-wise citation precision; falls back to location correctness when null.
